ticker: Overtone · automatic timing for osu! maps
Every timing shows its confidence: check it before you rank
Open source · the engine runs offline on your own machine too
Sign in with your Mides account · Discord or Google

home.title: Time a song in minutes, not hours
home.subtitle: Upload the audio and Overtone finds the BPM, the offset and every red line, and tells you how sure it is about each section.
home.secondary: Sign in to keep your history
home.honest: Overtone does not promise perfect timing. Its benchmark is exact on synthetic tracks; on real ranked maps it is a strong first draft. Confidence is shown so you know where to look.

upload.title: Upload, get red lines
upload.body: BPM, offset, bars and signature changes, ready to paste into [TimingPoints].

confidence.title: Confidence per section
confidence.body: Every section says how much evidence backs it, instead of a number that looks precise.

analyze.title: Analyze a song
analyze.subtitle: Upload the audio and Overtone finds the BPM, the offset and every red line. The audio is analysed and then deleted: only its fingerprint and the result are kept.
analyze.audioHint: MP3, OGG, WAV, FLAC, M4A or Opus.
analyze.tooLong: This song is {{minutes}} minutes long; the limit is {{limit}}.
analyze.drop: Drop songs or a folder here, or choose files
analyze.privacy: No account needed. Your file is deleted as soon as it is analysed; the same audio uploaded again gets the stored result at once.
analyze.limitsNote: A Mides account raises the daily limit and keeps your history.
analyze.honest: Overtone's timing is exact on its synthetic benchmark, but on real ranked maps it is still being measured. Treat every result as a strong first draft and check it by ear before you rank.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Choose an MP3, OGG, WAV, FLAC, M4A or Opus file.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {{limit}} MB.
errors.QUOTA_ANON: Without an account you can analyse {{limit}} songs a day. Sign in for more, or come back after 00:00 UTC.
errors.QUOTA_ACCOUNT: You have used today's {{limit}} analyses. The count resets at 00:00 UTC.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many uploads in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.PENDING_LIMIT_one: You already have {{count}} song in the queue. Send more when it finishes.
errors.PENDING_LIMIT_other: You already have {{count}} songs in the queue. Send more when one finishes.
errors.QUEUE_FULL: The queue is full right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.CACHE_LIMIT: You have opened {{count}} stored results today. The count resets at 00:00 UTC.

analyze.privateHint: The queue then shows only that something is being analysed: no song, no file name, no uploader.
analyze.atOnce_one: Up to {{count}} song in the queue at once
analyze.atOnce_other: Up to {{count}} songs in the queue at once

batch.title: {{finished}}/{{total}} ready
batch.notify: Notify me when the whole batch is done

result.notFound: It does not exist, or it was started in another browser. Analyses are visible only to whoever started them.
result.reconnecting: Lost contact with the server; trying again…
result.queuedNote: Your song is waiting for the analysis worker. You can leave this page open or come back to it later.

stages.fallback: No steady grid: trying the beat tracker
stages.vote: Checking the beats with Beat This!

result.failed: Overtone could not read this file. It may be damaged or not the audio its name says. Your file has been deleted.

refusal.no_pulse: Overtone found no steady pulse in this audio, so it does not report a BPM.
refusal.too_short: This audio is too short to time: it needs at least two seconds.
refusal.too_long: This audio is longer than the limit.
refusal.refused: Overtone could not time this audio.

result.refusedWhy: A guessed BPM would look precise and be wrong. Noise, ambient pads and free-time music end here on purpose.
result.meterGuess: The bar was not proved by the accents: check where it starts.
result.oszFailed: The .osz could not be built from this file. The copy and the CSV still work.
result.oszNote: Open the .osz and osu! imports it as a new map with these red lines and no notes, ready for the editor. It is built here, from your file: nothing is uploaded.
result.oszNeedsAudio: The .osz carries the song: pick it above to build it.
result.copyFailed: Could not copy: use the download
result.honest: Check these red lines by ear before you rank. Overtone is exact on its synthetic benchmark, but its accuracy on real ranked maps is still research: amber sections need a listen first, and so may the rest.
result.cached: same audio analysed before: stored result
result.removed: A moderator took this song off the queue, so it was not analysed. Its file has been deleted.

login.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this server.
login.privacy: Overtone only keeps your public Mides profile: name, avatar and banner. Never your email.

footer.tagline: Automatic timing for osu!, measured and honest about its confidence.

queue.title: Queue
queue.subtitle: Every song waiting for the analyser or being analysed right now, and the ones that finished in the last hour.
queue.privacy: A song is named by its own tags, or by its file name when it has none. Anyone who ticked "keep it off the public queue" shows here as a private upload. Folders and paths are never shown, the audio is never served, and only you can open your own results.

tempo.canvasLabel: The song's timeline with {{count}} red lines, the local tempo, the waveform, the onsets and their drift from the grid. The red lines are also listed in the table below.
tempo.overview: The whole song: click or drag to move the view
tempo.followHint: Turn the page with the playhead while playing (F)
tempo.tipBefore: Before the first red line: osu! runs its grid backwards here, which holds only if the intro keeps that tempo.

legend.grid: Beats and bars of the red lines

tempo.howTo: Wheel to zoom, drag to pan, click to seek or to pick a red line, Shift-drag to loop a span (it snaps to beats; Alt keeps it free).
tempo.howToTouch: Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, tap to seek or to pick a red line.
tempo.loopSection: the red line's section under the playhead
tempo.keys: Space plays · ← → a beat (Shift: a bar) · + − zoom · 0 fits · [ ] red lines · L loop · C clicks · F follow

audio.none: Pick {{name}} again to hear it with the clicks and to see its waveform.
audio.checking: Checking it is the same audio…
audio.decoding: Decoding the song in this browser…
audio.mismatch: {{name}} is not the audio this analysis timed: its fingerprint differs. Pick the same file you uploaded.
audio.unverifiable: This analysis has no fingerprint to check a file against, so it cannot be played here.
audio.error: This browser cannot decode this file. The timing below does not depend on it.
audio.privacy: The song is read here, on your device, and checked against the analysis by its SHA-1. The server never keeps or sends audio.

tempo.driftHint: How far the onsets under this red line sit from its grid (the nearest 1/1, 1/2, 1/3 or 1/4 tick): the weighted median, in ms.
tempo.driftDetail: 90th percentile, and which way the onsets lean (+: after the grid)
tempo.residualHint: The engine's own grid-fit residual for this section, in ms.
tempo.tableNote: Hover or pick a row to find its red line on the map. Confidence is the engine's own reading of its fit, not a measured accuracy; drift is measured from the onsets it kept.
tempo.confidenceNote: Confidence is the engine's own, not a measured accuracy: check every section by ear.
tempo.factorNote: Every BPM halved or doubled, for the map, the clicks and the exports. The engine's reading is unchanged; pick the one that sounds right against the clicks.
tempo.nudgeNote: Moves every red line by the same ms, the clicks and the exports with them. An adjustment to check by ear, not a measurement.
tempo.adjusted: These numbers are adjusted by you: the copy and the downloads carry the adjustment and say so in a comment line. Check it by ear before you use it.
tempo.hint: From {{from}} to {{to}} the onsets thin out to every other beat: the engine reads this as possible half- or double-time inside one red line (the amber mark). Evidence, not a red line: listen to it.
tempo.swing: From {{from}} to {{to}} the off-beat eighth lands late, about {{late}} ms ({{snap}} of the beat): swing. Snap those notes by ear.

moderation.removePrompt: Remove this job from the queue? It fails and its audio is deleted. Reason for the log (optional):
moderation.requeuePrompt: Hand this running job back to the queue? Reason for the log (optional):

errors.NOT_LIVE: It is not waiting or running any more.
errors.NOT_RUNNING: Only a running job can be handed back.
errors.AUDIO_GONE: Its audio is gone: it cannot be analysed again.

did.requeue: @{{moderator}} handed a job back to the queue

cancel.notQueued: It is already being analysed and can no longer be cancelled.
cancel.failed: It could not be cancelled. Try again.

status.title: Service status
status.description: Whether the Overtone API, its database and the analysis worker are up right now.
status.intro: What the site's own health check says right now. It asks again every 30 seconds while this page is open, and less often while the service does not answer.

notes.database: Keeps the queue, the results and the accounts.
notes.worker: Runs the analyses. While it is down, uploads wait in the queue.
notes.workerUnknown: No worker has called since the API last started.
notes.unreachable: The API did not answer, so the rest cannot be checked.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: This page hit an error and stopped. Reloading usually fixes it; your uploads and results on the server are not affected.
